insights.question: What pick/ban tendencies repeat most?
insights.title: Orianna is always on their mind
insights.text: They pick or ban Orianna in 33/78 games (42%): 10 picks (8-2) and 23 bans.

insights.question: How does the draft shift in Fearless G2/G3+?
insights.title: In G3+ they stay closer to their core than most
insights.text: In 24 G3+ games, 32/120 picks (27%) were champions they never played in any G1 (league 42%). Pool: 57 champs in G1s, 59 in G3+.

insights.question: How does the draft shift in Fearless G2/G3+?
insights.title: No Ezreal? They go Kalista
insights.text: Ezreal is a G1 favorite (9/27 G1s, played by Tactical). In the 18 later games where it was burned or banned, Tactical went to Kalista (3/18) and Caitlyn (3/18).

insights.question: What pick/ban tendencies repeat most?
insights.title: Teams respect-ban Ziggs against them
insights.text: Opponents banned Ziggs against them in 34/78 games (44%).
